past_recommendations.text: Record the updated entry-bar verdict — on `tradeable_3d` the bar is a coin flip (16/28 decided sessions, p ≈ 0.57, 29 paired sessions; question answered, not open). On `entry_r` it is a modest edge that **weakened** this cycle (18/28, p ≈ 0.19, versus 18/27 / p ≈ 0.12 at #25 and 17/25 / p ≈ 0.11 at #23). Size by score tier; never defend the bar on `tradeable_3d`.

Record the strengthened day-conditioning result in the scorer documentation — paired edge **+11.2 pp on the 14 sessions where control itself ran ≥55% tradeable (12/14 won, p = 0.013)** vs **−3.7 pp on the other 15 (4/15 won, 10 lost)**. Third consecutive strengthening reading (#23 +12.3/11, #25 +10.5/13, #26 +11.2/14). The bar amplifies breadth rather than selecting within a session. Both cells under the 20-session gate — watch, and note the low-breadth cell is dominated by sessions with surfaced n ≤ 2 (8 of 15).

Emit a T1-equivalent reversal gate (0.5×ATR) alongside the 1.0×ATR gate for reporting comparability only — 16/26 (61.5%) of visible non-tradeable reversal first-flags reached ≥0.5 ATR, which would move the visible reversal rate from 54.4% to 82.5%. Reporting change, not a trading change. Sixth cycle requested.

Restore omitted-row coverage for reversal earliness, or state the limit in the output contract — 87 older surfaced rows are omitted, leaving 57 of 98 reversal first-flags visible, and that subset runs 54.4% tradeable against the cohort's 46.9%. Earliness levels computed here are optimistic by ~7–8 pp; only the shape is trustworthy.

Add the standing cluster-concentration note to the bounce performance headline — `bounce_2026-07-28` (19/19) and `bounce_2026-07-17` (13/13) supply 26.9% of bounce first-flags and 36.0% of its wins from 2 of 46 clusters; 68.0% cluster-weighted is the quotable figure.

bounce | POOLED | prior_day_range_atr | 1.0 required, all caps, both SETUP_PROFILES | demote to zero-weight bonus check (do NOT invert to <1.0) | pass ≥1.0 cw 64.2% (30 clusters) vs fail <1.0 cw 75.0% (20 clusters) = −10.8 pp wrong-signed; unchanged across #24/#25/#26/#27, carried not re-derived this cycle; re-express the bar as 4-of-5 CAUTION / 5-of-5 GO and re-run the cohort tables before shipping

Withdraw the 0–2 breadth damp from #25/#26 — EV has decayed −0.34R → −0.20R → −0.06R → +0.01R across four readings while sessions grew 27 → 30, and the sign has now flipped. The justification ("stable negative sign") no longer holds; do not ship a damp, and close the cell or re-open it only if it goes negative again at 35+ sessions.
Ship the bounce `prior_day_range_atr` demotion. Fourth consecutive cycle as the only gated actionable finding (#24, #25, #26, #27), re-reported four times with no change landing.

Stop running this analysis on cadence and implement the #24 cell-gate watcher. #27 added one bounce session and zero new first-flags to either cohort; every criterion cell is carried from #26 verbatim. One query per session over the named open cells (bounce `prior_day_range_atr` fail, bounce `selloff_total_pct ≤ −0.25`, 0-of-3 veto, reversal `prior_day_rvol ≥ 2.0`, reversal Large cap, the control-≥55% day-conditioning cell, the new reversal-range cell) plus the 0–2 breadth band, firing on a gate crossing.

Force the Large-cap reversal GO decision — now outstanding #17 through #27, ten cycles. Large 42.9% visible / cw 35.8% at 17 clusters vs Medium 69.2% visible / cw 68.5%, with reversal first-flags arriving at ~0–1 per cycle; the cell will never reach 20 clusters on this trajectory. Either suspend Large-cap reversal GO on the 17-cluster evidence and label it provisional, or record explicitly that it will be traded unchanged until the drought ends. An eleventh deferral is itself a decision to keep trading the worse cap.

Ship the bounce earliness instrumentation — emit `adverse_before_gate_atr` and `days_to_gate` keyed to the per-bucket gate. Unshipped since #18; bounce earliness is unanalyzable for the seventh consecutive cycle.

Emit cluster-weighted `entry_r` by score tier in the pre-aggregated tables. Requested at #20, #21, #22, #24, #25, #26, now #27. The score-5 median of 2.50R is the sole basis for size-by-tier, is non-monotonic against both score 4 (1.77R) and score 6 (1.72R), and cannot be audited for cluster concentration without it.

Emit a T1-equivalent reversal gate (0.5×ATR) alongside the 1.0×ATR gate for reporting comparability only — 15/25 (60%) of visible non-tradeable reversal first-flags reached ≥0.5 ATR, which would move the visible reversal rate from 53.6% to 80.4%. Reporting change, not a trading change. Seventh cycle requested.

Restore omitted-row coverage for reversal earliness or state the limit in the output contract — 88 older surfaced rows are omitted, leaving 56 of 98 reversal first-flags visible at 53.6% tradeable against the cohort's 46.9%. All earliness levels in this report are optimistic by ~6.7 pp; only the shape is trustworthy.

Fix the priority_report CLUSTER DAY comment — delete the 7–14 = −0.50R/10-session claim (now +0.10R/12 sessions, seventh opposite-sign cycle) as justification for the 7→15 raise, remove any monotonic-gradient language (3–6 at +0.27R exceeds both higher bands and 15+ has the worst win rate at 38.6%), and document the 15-window threshold as judgment-set and unvalidated at 3 sessions.

Record the entry-bar verdict in the scorer documentation — on `tradeable_3d` the bar is a coin flip (17/29 decided sessions, p ≈ 0.46, 30 paired sessions; question answered, not open). On `entry_r` it is a modest edge that is not strengthening (19/29, +0.94R mean, p ≈ 0.14, versus 18/28 / p ≈ 0.19 at #26 and 18/27 / p ≈ 0.12 at #25). Size by score tier; never defend the bar on `tradeable_3d`.

Record the day-conditioning result — paired edge +11.2 pp on the 14 sessions where control itself ran ≥55% tradeable (12/14 won, p ≈ 0.013) vs −0.5 pp on the other 16 (5/16 won, 10 lost, 1 tie). The high-breadth cell is unchanged from #26; the low-breadth cell softened only because the single new session contributed +47.9 pp off surfaced n=1, and 9 of its 16 sessions have surfaced n ≤ 2. The bar amplifies breadth rather than selecting within a session. Both cells under the 20-session gate — watch.

Add the standing cluster-concentration note to the bounce performance headline — `bounce_2026-07-28` (19/19) and `bounce_2026-07-17` (13/13) supply 26.9% of bounce first-flags and 36.0% of its wins from 2 of 46 clusters; 68.0% cluster-weighted is the quotable figure.

Ship the bounce prior_day_range_atr demotion. Fifth consecutive cycle as the only gated actionable finding (#24–#28), now backed by a fresh row-level re-derivation rather than a carried figure. Nothing has landed in four prior attempts.

Correct the SETUP_PROFILES annotation for pct_change_3 — the inline "V2: 3-day momentum crash (rho=−0.700, #2 predictor)" does not reproduce. On 112 first-flags at 94% coverage the cut runs wrong-signed (65.5% vs 77.1%; cw 56.5% on 13 clusters). Mark it unvalidated pending the cell reaching 20 clusters; do not change the threshold yet.

Pair the range demotion with a depth reweight when the selloff_total_pct cell reaches 20 clusters (currently 15) — deep selloff is the only bounce criterion that separates (cw 93.3% vs 62.3%, +31.0 pp) and is the natural recipient of the weight freed by demoting range.

Either suspend Large-cap reversal GO on the 18-cluster evidence and label it provisional, or record explicitly that it will be traded unchanged until the drought ends. A twelfth deferral is itself a decision to keep trading the worse cap.

Emit a T1-equivalent reversal gate (0.5×ATR) alongside the 1.0×ATR gate for reporting comparability only — 16/26 visible non-tradeable reversal first-flags reached ≥0.5 ATR (15/26 strictly above it), moving the visible reversal rate from 53.6% to 80.4–82.1%. Eighth cycle requested. Reporting change, not a trading change. Note for the record: #27's "15/25" denominator was a slip — the non-tradeable count is 26.

Ship the bounce earliness instrumentation — emit adverse_before_gate_atr and days_to_gate keyed to the per-bucket gate. Unshipped since #18; bounce earliness is unanalyzable for the eighth consecutive cycle.

Close the 0–2 breadth damp permanently. EV −0.34R → −0.20R → −0.06R → +0.01R → +0.03R across five readings (27 → 31 sessions); the sign flipped at #27 and has held positive. Re-open only if it returns negative at 35+ sessions.

The score is not selecting within a session — document its role as a quantity limiter.

Narrow the omitted-row caveat in the output contract to reversal only — bounce coverage is 112/119 first-flags (94.1%) running 74.1% against the cohort's 74.8%, effectively unbiased; reversal coverage is 56/98 (57.1%) running 53.6% against 46.9%, optimistic by 6.7 pp. Stop labelling bounce criterion work as coverage-limited.

Size up at score 5 specifically; score 6 (3 clusters) and score 4-vs-below-bar remain unsupported. Still emit this in the pre-aggregated tables each cycle so it is auditable without re-derivation (requested #20–#28, supplied by hand here).

This is new row-level data against a settled parameter, but the coverage gap and the possibility that loser MAE postdates the exit point mean it must be confirmed on all 98 first-flags first.
